reviews.text: It was our first visit and we had a wonderful experience! Everyone was so kind, friendly, and welcoming. They made us feel comfortable, and we truly appreciated their care and professionalism. Highly recommend☺️ 🐾❤️
Ella Bella says thank you. Great vet.

I had a great experience with them, they were very professional and thorough, not to mention the empathy they showed both with my puppy and with me! They will be our go-to people from now on. Highly recommended!

I discovered this veterinary clinic when one of my cats was suffering from severe gastrointestinal issues that other vets had been unable to resolve. Since then, I've only taken my cats to them. Most importantly, Dr. Franco and her staff—always extremely kind, helpful, knowledgeable, and professional—are always reachable and respond promptly both by phone and via text messaging. This alone is worth the 5-star rating.

This experience was perfect in every way. From the initial meeting to the complete comprehensive care of our beloved cat, we felt like comfortable and confident with the professional care given at this incredible veteranian office.

Availability, professionalism, and kindness.
I recommend this veterinary clinic.

First visit today with Dr. Irene, who immediately proved to be loving, professional, and absolutely perfect in every way.
My Penelope really appreciated it.
Thank you so much ♥️

Dr. Irene Franco and her team of collaborators have always proven to be reliable, kind, and knowledgeable. Their passion for animal care goes far beyond their mere "profession." Our cats received meticulous care.
Great expertise and precision in diagnosis, professionalism and empathy towards each animal
The vets are very knowledgeable and helpful, and they're helping me a lot and consistently to care for my cat Pablo. I highly recommend this clinic for the great humanity you'll experience. <3

I would like to sincerely thank Dr. Irene Franco for her great professionalism, availability, and kindness. She assisted me on a Sunday, when my poodle had severe conjunctivitis, and immediately demonstrated attention, expertise, and great sensitivity.

She was very thorough during the examination, clear in her explanations, and truly caring towards my dog. In a time of great concern, knowing I could count on such a helpful and competent veterinarian was truly reassuring.

An excellent professional, who carries out her work with passion and a genuine love for animals. I absolutely recommend her without hesitation. Thank you again, Dr. Franco!

Dr. Franco and her entire staff have always treated my dog ​​with great professionalism and attention. They're always very kind and helpful. They've addressed my dog's various health issues on every occasion, providing me with all the necessary information with precision and demonstrating great empathy.
I highly recommend this excellent veterinary clinic!

Dr. Franco is fabulous...she does her job with passion and extreme expertise. She treated my cat, clearing up all my doubts and showing great empathy. I will forever be grateful and recommend her to everyone!

The Ambrosiana Clinic is a guarantee of professionalism. I returned for my Gigio after Carletto left me two years ago, and I found Dr. Irene with her usual attention to detail—empathetic, meticulous, and attentive. Virtually all tests can be performed at the clinic without having to travel to external facilities. And this, in my opinion, is very positive. All the doctors are very sweet with our furry friends.
We often enter the clinic worried, but we always leave calm, with a diagnosis and treatment.

My dog, Gordo, and I have been cared for by the team at the Ambrosia Veterinary Clinic since he arrived in our family in 2022.
Gordo has always been treated with the utmost care and attention. He had several health issues because, being a French Bulldog, he had digestive and breathing difficulties since he was a puppy. I entrusted myself to their care, and in February 2025, we decided to have surgery to correct his turbinates and soft palate. The operation went very well, and he is now significantly better.
I recommend the Ambrosia Veterinary Clinic because any problem your pet faces will be analyzed by expert and dedicated professionals.

I brought my cat to this clinic for a health issue, and I can only express my gratitude for the professionalism and compassion shown by all the staff.
From the first contact, they were extremely kind, helpful, and prompt in responding, making me feel supported in a time of concern. They cared for my cat with great attention and care.
One aspect I particularly appreciated was their availability: they left me a cell phone number I could contact at any time with any questions or needs.
I recommend this clinic to anyone looking for trained, attentive veterinarians who truly care about their patients and their families.

For years, we have relied on the Ambrosiana Veterinary Clinic, particularly Dr. Irene Franco. She has always been highly trained, competent, and attentive to the needs of our cat, who is now almost 14 years old. Irene has cared for him with great care, sensitivity, and professionalism in every situation, supporting us even during the most delicate moments with patience and compassion. Our cat has special needs and is very difficult to care for, but they have always managed to approach him appropriately. The entire staff has also proven to be knowledgeable, helpful, and welcoming. I highly recommend this facility!
The best clinic I've ever trusted. I found kindness and, above all, professionalism. Nothing is left to chance. Thank you for everything you've done over the years for my furry friends 😽 …

Piera has been treated by Dr. Irene Franco for several years. With professionalism and kindness, she has always ensured punctual, worry-free visits for my big dog. The remote service via WhatsApp is also very convenient, should you need to renew prescriptions or appointments.
RECOMMENDED

I couldn't have asked for a better staff to look after my corgi Audrey. They were competent, reliable, and incredibly knowledgeable. They even sang her a song to calm her down while they took her blood. ❤️

Dr. Irene Franco and her staff have been caring for Maya, our 14-year-old dog, for...14 years!!! Maya has had many problems, including two surgeries for a tumor. We have always been satisfied with the professionalism, courtesy, and empathy of Irene and the people who work with her. I hope your companions never have any problems. But if they do, this is the right place to take them!

Our experience was truly positive. The vet proved to be extremely competent, attentive, and helpful, both in a delicate situation when our poodle had an accident, and in her daily care and prevention efforts. During the most difficult times, she was reassuring and professional, while during routine checkups, she always stands out for her thoroughness, kindness, and great attention to the dog's well-being. She is a trusted partner.
I have been coming to the clinic with my dog ​​for 8 years. Professionalism, cleanliness, attention, and friendliness have always distinguished the service offered.

I've been having my dog ​​treated at the Ambrosiana Veterinary Clinic for 4 years. The doctors at the clinic are all highly trained and extremely friendly. They are always very transparent about the treatments offered and their costs. The environment is comfortable, and my dog ​​always arrives there feeling very calm. They believe it's important to them to carry out all necessary treatments with the utmost respect for the animal.

I brought my dog ​​Diana to the Ambrosiana Clinic in a rather serious condition. She's no longer young and was in truly terrible pain: I was desperate, because, in addition to her suffering, I felt utterly helpless at not being able to help her.
I came here thanks to word of mouth from someone who had told me about Dr. Franco, telling me how she had saved her dog from a serious hormonal disorder. I admit I wasn't confident, because previous experiences, though careful, had left me without any real solutions and with little hope.
Dr. Franco handled the situation with great expertise and humanity. She was extremely clear in explaining everything we would face, without hiding the seriousness of the case, but also making me understand that trying was the right choice, because the alternative would have been to see Diana deteriorate and suffer.
She was also always available, even via text, for any questions or concerns, which really made a difference for me at such a delicate time.
We faced the entire journey together: from the pre-operative procedures, to the splenectomy, to the hospitalization and post-hospitalization phase, always with the utmost care.
A heartfelt thank you also to the entire highly professional medical team who worked with her.

The therapy is still long, but today I finally have confidence that my dog ​​can have a better quality of life.

For my first experience, I found the staff at the Ambrosiana Veterinary Clinic to be highly competent, attentive, and helpful. They were always available to answer any questions and were very thorough. Thank you!
They are very kind people, my dog ​​is always very calm when she goes to the vet

Dr. Irene Franco and the Ambrosiana Veterinary Clinic were recommended to us by a friend after our cat was ill for several months without any solution, and she continued to struggle with growth and weight loss. Luckily, we met some incredibly competent and compassionate professionals who helped us resolve all her issues. She's now our trusted veterinarian. Highly recommended!
Great professionalism, combined with extreme availability and courtesy. I also greatly appreciated the gentle way in which my cat was handled during visits and exams.
Always the utmost care and attention towards my dog. Very kind and friendly staff.

I wanted to sincerely thank the Ambrosiana Veterinary Clinic for their hospitality on a very painful day.

Adama was very ill, and even though they didn't know us, they welcomed us with a hug and truly extraordinary professionalism. They cared for her with skill and care, but also for me, with a sensitivity and humanity I will never forget.

Thank you for the authenticity, kindness, and great professionalism you demonstrated during such a difficult time. 🤍
I have been a client for years and have always found the entire clinic staff helpful and friendly, especially Dr. Franco, who always has valuable advice for my dog's care.
Dr. Franco and her staff are knowledgeable, competent, clear, and empathetic in their communication, and incredibly gentle with animals, as well as always available. I highly recommend them!

We came to this veterinary clinic for the first time, bringing our kitten for an eye problem, and we couldn't have made a better choice. Dr. Irene Franco was simply extraordinary: extremely professional, competent, and excellent at her job, but above all, she possessed a sensitivity and love for animals that was immediately apparent.

The way she interacted with our cat truly struck us: sweet, affectionate, warm... she literally hugged him and gave him a kiss, and it was one of the most endearing and reassuring things we've ever seen. It's clear that this isn't just a job for her, but a true calling.

The assistants are also extremely kind, helpful, and always smiling, creating a peaceful and welcoming environment for both animals and owners.

Unfortunately, we're coming off a bad experience at another clinic, where they made us keep returning without ever truly solving our cat's problem, only making us waste money. Here, however, the problem was addressed and resolved with great skill and honesty, as well as a truly rare kindness.

I have only positive things to say: professionalism, kindness, expertise, and so much love for animals. We will definitely be back and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy veterinarian. ❤️🐾

The clinic's doctors are always available, even by phone, in case of emergencies or for advice of any kind. They are meticulous and conduct every examination with punctuality and precision. They also collaborate with external specialists with whom appointments can be scheduled if necessary. We have dogs and cats; each of our animals has always been cared for with care and sensitivity. I recommend the facility for any need: from a simple checkup to more complex situations.

We've been bringing our dog Pita to the Ambrosiana Clinic for five years now, and we're cared for by its director, Irene, and we couldn't be luckier. The care, attention, and professionalism she provides for Pita are impeccable, always accompanied by great availability and a rare sense of warmth. She's a precious resource for us and our dog!
At the Ambrosiana Veterinary Clinic, I found professionalism, helpfulness, competence, and empathy. Highly recommended.
Professional, well-prepared and truly sweet with animals
We've always had a good time here; the atmosphere is welcoming and clean. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly, always ready for any eventuality.

Today I took my dog ​​to this clinic for a vaccination and I was truly satisfied! The staff was extremely kind, helpful, and professional from the very first moment. They treated my dog ​​with great care and attention: thanks to their expertise, he felt virtually nothing during the vaccination.

The office environment is welcoming, and the entire team was very polite and attentive to our needs. A truly positive experience, I will definitely return and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a quality veterinary clinic!

The clinic, headed by Dr. Franco, has been treating our cats for many years with great expertise and empathy. The entire staff is always available and prompt, even in managing emergencies. I would recommend it to anyone!

We've been relying on the Ambrosiana Veterinary Clinic for years
for our cats. We've always found them professional, empathetic, and helpful.

My cat gets sick every holiday season, and luckily we found this clinic where Dr. Irene Franco was super kind and professional, even though it's December 8th.
Thank you for saving our tree and our holiday ❤️
A clinic where you're greeted with kindness and expertise. And above all, great attention. Highly recommended.
Moka, the only living being, was so happy to go to the doctor... thanks to Irene and Micol ❤️
Exceptional experience, the doctor was great with my dog ​​who was very scared.

I was passing through Milan and my cat had a problem. The doctors were very attentive and helpful during the visit, and they asked for updates on the situation even afterward.
Even though my experience was brief, I highly recommend the clinic.

The veterinarians working at this clinic are all highly experienced and, above all, veterinarians with a love for animals. Dr. Franco has been our veterinarian for almost 20 years. She has always helped, supported, and guided us with all our dogs in making the best decisions for the animal's well-being. I have dealt with very few professionals with this level of seriousness and professionalism. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a place to find support and love for their pet.

I was very happy to bring my dog ​​Marshall. My daughter called me telling me that our dog had drooping lips because another dog had attacked him in the park. I immediately called the Ambrosiana clinic and they told me to bring him. He had surgery and my little dog recovered without problems. It seems that Hubiese never had an accident. They are very grateful to all of them, they are all kind and helpful.
Attentive, friendly, and professional service and availability. Dr. Franco and her staff have been caring for my cats with care and attention for years.
Dr. Franco is extremely kind, helpful, and professional. I highly recommend this clinic!

Recommended by a veterinarian friend, who says she's the best in town!
I've been going there with my two dogs for seven years and I'm very happy with her. Irene is always very helpful and knowledgeable. I trust her advice completely.

Clinica Ambrosiana is highly recommended! Medical Director Dr. Irene Franco has an incredible humanity (which permeates everyone's work) and professionalism. The staff is exceptional, starting with the talented Nicole, and the equipment is state-of-the-art.
At Clinica Ambrosiana, our dogs and cats are treated as if they were their own, with skill and integrity! Well done!

A top-notch veterinary clinic. The doctors are caring and loving with our four-legged "children." Dr. Sofia Mastellaro and Dr. Viscardi treat our animals with love and, above all, professionalism. And above all, they offer no-obligation advice on how to proceed with our animals. I highly recommend them. Their professionalism and kindness are unmatched.

Kindness and professionalism!
Highly recommended!

The staff at the Ambrosiana Veterinary Clinic is wonderful and competent. For years, they have been the go-to person for me and my cat, Maggie. Dr. Irene Franco, in particular, is a unique person, both personally and professionally, with great dedication to what she does. Always available, kind, and loving, she is also extremely knowledgeable in her work. I couldn't have found a better person to whom I could entrust my beloved Maggie. I highly recommend the clinic and Dr. Franco in particular. Thank you so much for all the love you put into your work.

When I moved to Milan, I was advised to take my first golden retriever, Roy, to Dr. Franco, and we found her to be competent, welcoming, and incredibly helpful! She supported us even through great difficulties with dedication and care. Today, she looks after Joe Black, my "puppy," with special affection. She and her entire team are a guarantee!

Excellent clinic: competent, kind, and always available staff, meticulous care. I immediately felt in good hands. Highly recommended for anyone looking for professionalism and genuine attention to their pets.

I stumbled upon them by chance, and since then I've only taken my cat to them because, in addition to being very professional, I find them empathetic, both with us owners and with the animals. Patient, helpful, and honest. They truly love their work, and it shows. I highly recommend them. V.G.V

A very positive experience! I was greeted with great kindness and empathy by Dr. Franco when I brought my cat who was having breathing problems. She performed all the tests with great professionalism and care, providing us with a diagnosis and effective treatment. The location was very welcoming and clean. I highly recommend her.

I went for my annual thyroid checkup to make sure my Euthyrox was still working, and I walked out spending €350! They independently decided to run additional tests I hadn't requested and to perform a physical examination (2 minutes in total), for which they charged me €40. I will never return. I felt absolutely robbed and cheated. Very bad.
Highly recommended for their competence, professionalism, intellectual honesty, availability, and respect for all animals.

I must say this clinic is truly excellent. The doctor is wonderful with our little friends. And the rest of the staff is also highly qualified and always kind. They are always available for any clarification or advice for the well-being of our little furry friends. Highly recommended.

I went to this clinic this morning on the advice of my vet for a problem with my dog ​​Penny....I can only speak highly of it....very kind staff, the doctor who performed the ultrasound was kind, prepared, she explained things to us by showing us on the monitor....always with an eye on our dog.....kind and organized reception staff. Thank you so much for everything from me and Penny
Reliable and nice

Incredible expertise and professionalism.
Doctors with unparalleled courtesy.
Highly recommended.

Vale and Diego, the dachshund
Even though the outcome of my kitten's visit was disastrous, I can only be satisfied with the clinic and the people who work there.
Beautiful and helpful staff, we are so grateful for their competence and help
Super helpful and professional. My Blue is in good hands.

Highly professional staff, they care for their patients with love and dedication.
The best clinic we've ever been to; once you get to know them, you'll never leave!
And what about the medical director? Dr. Franco reassures you, explains everything, and pampers your friend with a passion few possess!
There are so many more stars to give!
Well done!
They were really kind, polite and super helpful, they were able to help me and give useful advice.

After 12 nightmare days spent in veterinary offices and clinics, I met a wonderful person, Dr. Irene Franco. She is not only highly professional and competent, but also possesses a rare humanity and kindness. She saved my 12-day-old puppy, …
